app.message: Service hostmode binds node ports, so replicas are replaced stop-first (brief downtime per replica)
app.hint: Publish through the load balancer (remove `mode: host` or `x-dockflow.publish: hostport`) to keep start-first updates.

app.message: Service hostport binds node ports, so replicas are replaced stop-first (brief downtime per replica)
app.hint: Publish through the load balancer (remove `mode: host` or `x-dockflow.publish: hostport`) to keep start-first updates.

app.message: 127.0.0.1:8000:8000/tcp binds the host port to 127.0.0.1, so only the node that runs the pod can reach it
app.hint: Remove the address to bind the port on every address of that node.
